notes.title: Release 1.0.1 - Patch Notes 6/24
notes.content:
Hi everyone, thanks for playing Spellbound Spire so far. We have been paying close attention to all the issues encountered and are working actively to resolve them. 

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
  - Soft lock ball slide puzzle
  - Soft lock ball window  
  - Portal Popping in when opening door
  - Achievements not unlocking
  - Fixed being able to play in 2D debug
  - Fixed confusing blue key game play moment

[b]Update:[/b]
  Within the upcoming weeks we plan to update the game with a bigger patch containing the following and more.
  - Audio Improvements
  - Minor Level layout changes
  - Reducing visual bugs
  - More Poses for the Index Controllers
  and more...

notes.title: Spellbound Spire - Official Release
notes.content:
[h1]Release Patch Notes[/h1]

Hey everyone, 
Thank you all for playing Spellbound Spire during our beta. Your feedback helped us improve the game a lot! So without further ado: Spellbound Spire is now released!

[h2]General Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Performance improvements 
[*]Removed debug text
[*]Added Easter eggs
[*]Improved stability of moving hands through portals[/list]

[h2]Audio:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Updated sound mixing 
[*]Updated sound effects 
[*]Updated ambiance set dressing
[*]Added cutscene audio[/list]

[h2]Graphics & UI:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved Lighting across all levels
[*]Improved set dressing across all levels
[*]Updated hand UI[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed oculus booting issue
[*]Fixed fade to black in walls
[*]Fixed floor tiling
[*]Fixed various soft-lock moments[/list]

[h2]Ongoing:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Safety and security fixes[/list]

We are still listening closely to your feedback to further improve our game.

notes.title: Spellbound Spire - Beta Version 1.3 Released
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes version Beta 1.3[/h1]

Hey everyone,
Thank you to everyone playing Spellbound spire during our beta, especially those taking the time to report any issues they encounter via our discord or form.

We added quite a few changes and updates to the game. We are listening closely to your feedback, and have identified and resolved a number of issues. The beta version 1.3 is now live! 

[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Performance improvements 
[*] Pose for snail changed, you can now look at its face
[*] Added fade to black when going through a wall
[*] Objects can hover towards hand when on ground
[*] Updated Credits
[*] More Transition pieces
[*] Acquire gravity powers later in the game
[/list]
[h2]Audio[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated sound mixing
[*] Updated sound effects
[*] Updated atmospheric set dressing
[/list]
[h2]Graphics & UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved font
[*] Improved Lighting across all levels 
[*] Updated various textures & materials
[*] Set-dressed levels
[*] Added ending VFX
[*] Added Wind and Sand VFX Effects inside levels
[*] Updated existing VFX effects
[*] New Skybox
[*] Added various decals
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Prevent players from playing the game in non-VR mode
[*] Fixed ghost pots
[*] Fixed height issue Oculus Rift S 
[*] Fixed teleportation issues hand and objects
[*] Fixed visual issues object clones
[*] Fixed teleporting out of the level
[*] Fixed some cheating/ sequence breaking
[*] Fixed portal flickering
[*] Fixed Corruption grids not destroying objects held in hand
[*] Fixed Doors opening multiple times
[/list]
[h2]Ongoing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Safety and security fixes
[*] Improved Oculus Rift support
[/list]
[h3]And more...[/h3]
